event: PERIOD CHARACTERIZATION, NOT A DISCRETE ATTACK. Morris frames the whole window as quiet on the Arab-Jewish front: the revolt 'petered out' by May 1939; the war years were 'an extended breathing space'; the British 'managed to keep Jewish immigration down and the Arabs quiescent.' Documented violence 1940-Nov 1947 was Jewish-vs-British insurgency (Saison, Hebrew Resistance Movement, King David Hotel Jul 1946, Acre prison break May 1947) and intra-Arab killings of collaborators/land-sellers (Cohen's entire 1940-47 record). Morris's Arab-on-Jewish attack record (convoy ambushes, Hatikvah, urban bombings, Bedouin assaults on kibbutzim) begins Dec 1947, after the 30 Nov outbreak.
